descriptions.communities_list_search: Search Layers Digital communities by alias or name. Optional: community query, result limit, and skip offset. Returns matching community records for resolving the school context used by other commands.
descriptions.context_list_context: Fetch the authenticated Layers portal context. Optional: client platform and version. Returns the active community, user, and installed-app context needed to understand subsequent school API calls.
descriptions.home_list_discover: Fetch the Layers Digital home discovery feed. Optional: API version. Returns the dashboard cards and available school applications for the authenticated account.
descriptions.home_list_layers_agenda: Fetch the Layers Agenda summary shown on the school dashboard. Optional: API version. Returns upcoming agenda information without loading the full event timeline.
descriptions.home_list_layers_atendimentos: Fetch the Help Desk summary shown on the school dashboard. Optional: API version. Returns the current service-desk card data for the authenticated school account.
descriptions.home_list_layers_comunicados: Fetch the Announcements summary shown on the school dashboard. Optional: API version. Returns recent announcement card data; use post-delivery_create_paginate for the detailed inbox.
descriptions.me_list_me: List agenda identities available to the authenticated account. Optional: community alias and userId. Returns agenda profile records used to scope event synchronization.
descriptions.media_list_icon: Fetch metadata for the Layers Announcements application icon. Returns the icon resource object; use this only when an integration needs the app artwork.
descriptions.media_list_icon_2: Fetch metadata for the Layers Agenda application icon. Returns the icon resource object; use this only when an integration needs the app artwork.
descriptions.media_list_icon_3: Fetch metadata for the Layers Help Desk application icon. Returns the icon resource object; use this only when an integration needs the app artwork.
descriptions.notification-badge_list_notification_bad: Fetch notification badge totals for the authenticated Layers account. Returns per-application unread or pending counts suitable for compact status checks.
descriptions.post-delivery_create_paginate: Read a page of delivered school announcements from the embedded Announcements app. Required: batchSize and filters. Optional: community, userId, and next cursor. Returns announcement delivery hits; despite using POST, this operation is read-only.
descriptions.preferences_list_preferences: Fetch portal preferences for the authenticated Layers account. Returns the current user preference object, including application-launcher settings.
descriptions.preferences_update_preferences: Update portal preferences for the authenticated Layers account. Required: user preference object. Returns the updated preferences; preview with --dry-run before allowing this mutation.
descriptions.sso_list_me: Fetch the authenticated Layers Digital account profile. Returns identity and school-account metadata used to verify that the token belongs to the intended user and community.
descriptions.view_create_sync: Read agenda events changed since a timestamp from the embedded Agenda app. Required: months and since. Optional: community and userId. Returns event synchronization hits; despite using POST, this operation is read-only.
